title: Task Links Should Be Clickable
description: The pages links or any other links attached to a task should be clickable

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by rendering linked page slugs as /pages/<slug> anchors and attachment URIs as external anchors in the Tasks workbench Links/Attachments tabs. External links were already clickable. Validation: focused Tasks markup test and dotnet build passed.
